description: Native portfolio P&L attribution of the workbench's margined rates book (two bilateral swaps and a deposit) from the pricing market on the margin fixture's date to two host closing markets, under every Rust method: portfolio.attributePortfolioPnl, then portfolioAttributionExplainText, portfolioAttributionReconciliationCheck at a one-cent tolerance and portfolioAttributionPctOfTotalByBucket, and per position attribution.pnlAttributionExplainText, pnlAttributionResidualWithinTolerance and pnlAttributionPctOfTotalByBucket. The usd-ois-50bp closing market keeps the date; the roll-1m-25bp one rolls a month, where every method returns Rust's missing-fixing error. exact repeats metrics_based on usd-ois-50bp at a host tolerance of zero, where Rust reports the book not reconciled. The closing markets are stored because a host supplies them.
